Author: G.K.Ilanthiraiyan Bench: G.K.Ilanthiraiyan  W.P   BEFORE THE MADURAI BENCH OF MADRAS HIGH COURT  DATED: 26.11.2024  CORAM  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE G.K.ILANTHIRAIYAN  W.P (MD).No.28156 of 2024  Rosy Ranjitham ...Petition  Vs.

Rosy Ranjitham vs The Deputy Director on 26 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198097458/
1 3. The petitioner was arrested and remanded into judicial custody, in pursuant to the registration of the FIR in Cr.No.247 of 2024 for the offences under Sections 296(b), 132, 123, 351(3) BNS and Section 24(1) of the Cigarette and Other Tobacco Products Act, on 05.10.2024 on the allegation that the petitioner had sold the Tobacco products. 
4. Mr.S.Shanmugavel, learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the first respondent,
on instruction, would submit that the first respondent sealed the premises, which was run by the petitioner without any licence and selling the Food products including the unsafe foods. 
5. In pursuant to the registration of the criminal case as against the petitioner, the Designated Officer of the Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Tirunelveli passed an order on 15.10.2024, thereby, imposed a fine of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only)
as the first time offender under the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011. After payment of fine amount, the first respondent is directed to consider the request made by the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis petitioner seeking reopen the shop premises and pass orders on merits and in accordance with law within a period of two weeks thereafter.
6. With the above direction, the writ petition stands disposed of. No costs.
